artifacts.title: Thornton v. Westminster

matches.evidence: …be addressed by a court with familiar acquaintance of the events and parties." (BCO 39-2.3) BCO 31-2, paragraph 1 states that Sessions and Presbyteries “shall with due diligence and great discretion demand from [those subject to…
acquaintance of the events and parties." (BCO 39-2.3)

artifacts.synopsis: Westminster Presbytery erred in not conducting a complete BCO 31-2 investigation into the secret taping of a phone conversation by TE Frank Smith; the matter was remanded for proper investigation with witness testimony and examination of legal consequences. The complaint regarding partiality and unbiblical criteria for discipline was not proven by complainant.
